full_prompt_en: A square avant-garde painting centers a man and woman seated close together within a crowded mosaic of angular color. The background is packed with overlapping fragments of blue, yellow, red, white, brown, and black; partial figures appear at the upper left and right but are not separated from the busy surface by clear depth. At center-left, the man turns toward the woman, his face drawn in profile through pale ochre and gray planes. He wears a dark blue vest or jacket over a loose white shirt, with black lower clothing dissolved into surrounding shapes. One arm bends up near his shoulder, while the other hand lies low in his lap. At center-right, the woman faces him in a slight profile. Red and blue paint forms short dark hair or a close head covering, and pale pink-white tones shape her face and neck. Her bright yellow bodice and skirt occupy much of the lower right, crossed by orange, cream, violet, and blue patches. Her hands rest together in front of her. Behind them, bits of other heads and costume-like color interrupt the background, suggesting a lively gathering without a single clear room. The figures remain identifiable through their face-to-face placement, yet their garments and surroundings share the same fractured brushwork. Short broad strokes, hard triangular intersections, and irregular opaque patches expose an energetic painted surface. Light is not tied to a natural source; luminous cream facial planes and saturated yellow areas stand forward while navy and black fragments make pockets of shadow. The diagonal ribbons of warm color weave through cooler blue structures. The overall composition is rhythmic and crowded, balancing the central human exchange with an all-over pattern of broken color and overlapping forms.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形先锋派绘画把一男一女置于中央，他们相邻而坐，周围是拥挤的折角彩色镶嵌。背景塞满相互覆盖的蓝、黄、红、白、棕与黑色碎片；左上和右上出现局部人物，却未被清晰纵深从繁忙表面分开。中央偏左，男子转向女子，他的侧脸由浅赭和灰色平面画出。他穿松软白衫，外有深蓝背心或上衣，下半身黑色衣物消融在周围形状里。一条手臂弯到肩旁，另一只手低低落在膝上。中央偏右，女子稍侧身对着他。红蓝颜料组成短深发或贴头饰物，浅粉白色塑造面庞与颈部。明黄上身与裙装占据右下大部，并被橘、奶油、紫和蓝色块横切。双手在身前靠拢。两人背后，其他头部和衣饰般的色片打断底面，暗示热闹聚会，却没有一个明确房间。人物凭面对面的位置仍能辨识，但衣服与环境共享同样断裂的笔触。短而宽的笔痕、坚硬的三角交点和不规则不透明色片暴露出富有动势的颜料表面。光不附属于自然光源；发亮的奶油色脸部平面和饱和黄色区域向前突出，海蓝与黑色碎片形成暗影口袋。暖色斜带穿过较冷的蓝色结构。整体构图有节奏且拥挤，用满幅断裂色彩与遮挡形状平衡中央的人物交流。
style_prompt_en: This avant-garde painted style turns recognizable forms into interlocking angular fragments without losing the overall directional flow. Saturated cadmium yellow, crimson, cobalt, teal, cream, and smoky violet overlap in irregular patches, with navy and black supplying strong dark anchors. Broad opaque strokes and crisp triangular breaks make the surface tactile and active; outlines are partial, often replaced by a color boundary. Light is carried by warm pale planes and intense yellow rather than a single realistic source, while cool dark fragments open shallow recesses. Diagonal bands pass through a crowded field of smaller shapes, creating syncopated movement and little empty space. The resulting effect is energetic, mosaic-like, and boldly modern.
style_prompt_zh: 这种先锋派绘画风格把可辨形体转成相互咬合的折角碎片，同时不失整体方向流动。饱和镉黄、绯红、钴蓝、青绿、奶油和烟紫在不规则色片中重叠，海蓝与黑色提供有力暗锚。宽阔不透明笔触和清脆三角断口让表面有触感且活跃；轮廓是局部的，常被色彩边界取代。光由暖浅色平面和强烈黄色承载，而非单一写实光源；冷暗碎片打开浅浅的凹处。斜向色带穿过满布小形状的场面，制造错落运动，留白很少。最终效果有活力、如镶嵌，鲜明而现代。
theme_en: A man and woman amid a crowded mosaic of color
theme_zh: 男女二人置身拥挤的彩色镶嵌画面
name: Mikhail Larionov
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
